description: This file defines the ProtocolServices class providing distributed protocol utility methods for log consistency within Orleans runtime. It manages logging, error handling, and access to grain-specific information.

classes.name: ProtocolServices
classes.description: Provides log consistency protocol services, error handling, and logging for grain protocols within Orleans.

methods.name: ProtocolServices
methods.description: Constructor initializing the protocol service with grain context, logger, copier, and silo details.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the provided value using DeepCopier.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs a protocol error and optionally throws an exception with detailed message.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught at a specified location.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught in user code for a specific callback.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified log level, formatting message with grain ID and provided arguments.
